Each year’s RMD is taken first and unspent RMDs are reinvested in a taxable account; spending then comes from taxable savings, the traditional IRA and the Roth IRA, in that order. Roth IRAs have no RMDs for the owner. Not included: Medicare premium (IRMAA) and Social Security tax effects.
